output_list.criticism: The transfer function does not check if the recipient's balance will overflow. If the recipient's balance is greater than 2^256 - 1, the transfer will fail.
The transferFrom function does not check if the recipient's balance will overflow. If the recipient's balance is greater than 2^256 - 1, the transfer will fail.
The buy function does not check if the contract's balance will overflow. If the contract's balance is greater than 2^256 - 1, the buy function will fail.
The mintToken function does not check if the recipient's balance will overflow. If the recipient's balance is greater than 2^256 - 1, the mintToken function will fail.
The withdrawToOwner function does not check if the contract's balance will overflow. If the contract's balance is greater than 2^256 - 1, the withdrawToOwner function will fail.
